name: Andy Allen
title: Social Worker
description: Andy is trained in a variety of mental, sexual, and relationship health therapeutic interventions and uses an integrative approach. Andy has been trained in Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), ACT, Motivational Interviewing, Interpersonal Therapy, CBT, Gottman Method, and No Bullshit Therapy. Andy is the Director of Prideworthy, which supports LGBTQIA+ couples, gender questioning/exploration, transitioning and sexuality, and internalised homo/bi/trans-phobia. Member of AusPATH (Australian Professional Association for Trans, Gender Diverse, and non-binary Health) and the Society of Australian Sexologists.
specialties: EMDR, LGBTQIA+, trans and gender diverse, sexuality, relationships, polyamory/ethical non-monogamy
identity: 'our counsellors bring a lived experience of being queer' (Prideworthy, Andy's own practice)
